payload.expected_mechanism: A Writer-skill revision that upgrades the retry rule: attempt 2 must start from a fresh requirement checklist derived from the issue and the visible tests, must select a different implementation strategy with a one-line rationale, and must verify the complete visible suite and every checklist item locally before finalizing.
payload.hypothesis: All five v3r5b H0 failures (astropy, sympy, seaborn, pytest, sphinx) fail at the official_eval stage: real patches that pass the visible verifier but miss hidden acceptance. Across six evolution rounds the only rescues ever observed (matplotlib in c8 and v3r4) both came from the attempt-2 different-approach rule, never from first-attempt guidance alone. The remaining chronic set is unchanged by checklist enumeration and minimal-diff discipline. Hypothesis: a mandatory, structured attempt-2 discipline converts a subset of the chronic failures — on retry, the Writer must (1) re-derive a requirement checklist from BOTH the issue text AND the visible test names and assertions, (2) choose a different implementation strategy from the failed attempt and name it in one line before editing, and (3) re-run the full visible suite plus the checklist before finalizing. Because the rule only activates on a failed first attempt, the five-case regression set (django, matplotlib, xarray, requests, sklearn) faces unchanged first-attempt behavior and stays green. A hypothesis from the evolution-failure projections, not causal truth.
validation_plan: Freeze the candidate through the governed request/Writer/check/commit path with the attribution bound.
Execute the evolution set (v3r5b H0 failures) under the frozen H1 with identical inputs.
Execute the complete regression set (all v3r5b H0-resolved cases) under the frozen H1; any regression rejects the candidate and triggers governed rollback.
